label: Australian residential transfer duty
field.name: Name
field.jurisdiction: State where the home is located
help.property: Link a planned home with a fixed purchase date to use its settlement and price, or enter the purchase details directly.
help.value: Use nominal AUD. For a linked home, enter the higher verified market value or consideration if it exceeds the purchase price. For an unlinked home, enter the full dutiable value.
field.victorianPrincipalResidence: Eligible for Victoria’s principal residence concession
help.victorianPrincipalResidence: The ordinary concession applies on values up to AUD 550,000. Verify that you meet the move-in and 12 months’ occupancy requirements.
help.standard: Use for standard established owner-occupied residential land, up to two hectares in NSW. First-home programs, foreign-buyer surcharges and special concessions are separate.
invalid.name: Enter a name of 1 to 80 characters.
invalid.profile: Confirm an ordinary established residential purchase.
invalid.contract: Choose a contract date covered by the supported state rates.
invalid.settlement: Choose a settlement date on or after signing.
invalid.jurisdiction: Choose New South Wales or Victoria.
invalid.property: Choose an active planned home with a fixed settlement date.
invalid.amount: Enter the positive dutiable value or link a home with a purchase price.
invalid.duplicate: Use one residential transfer duty expense per linked home.
